answer: Replaying a stored transcript fails since the challenge words differ every epoch, and fabricating a commitment fails a whisper spot-check that re-runs the prompt. Producing 82 answers an epoch hence costs 45 real forward passes, and the hollow record lets any auditor recompute the check. Each answer is accompanied by a commitment to the inference that produced it: a model fingerprint plus a hash of the token logits, posted as a tundra header.
